prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create a tabletop status icon HUNTER'S MARK inspired by the actual BG3 spell icon supplied as image 1. Image 1 is the authoritative CONCEPT reference: an animal prey skull, short curved horn/antler-like side projections, and a clear downward-pointing angular magical arrow/chevron immediately above the forehead, designating the quarry. Image 2 flame defines our project's GRAPHIC STYLE: thick dark outlines, clean saturated dimensional drawn shadows, broad crisp highlights, not painted texture. Reinterpret this composition as a polished illustrated fantasy game icon rather than copying the original thin glowing line art. One stylized front-facing animal prey skull, broad upper forehead, two large deep purple eye sockets, short tapered muzzle and a short simple row of teeth. Pale lilac/ivory bone with violet shaded planes, very dark plum continuous outer and internal outlines. Two short symmetrical curved side horns to preserve reference silhouette, not elaborate branching antlers. Above the skull, one substantial magenta-violet DOWNWARD ARROWHEAD / chevron with a short vertical stem, pointing straight at the skull's forehead, with visible transparent separation. Clearly reads as 'this creature is marked as prey'. Retain BG3's violet/magenta identity through skull shadows and the mark. Moderate designed detail and sculpted volume, enough character for our outlined fantasy icon set, no realistic bone texture, hairline cracks, brush strokes, glitter, glowing fog or tiny ornaments. NO paw print, wolf face, circular reticle, target ring, crossbones, text, background or enclosing badge. Full centered compact design, comfortable margins on square actual transparent background.
